title: Acceptance scenarios & risk ledger — Catalyst onramp
summary: Catalyst customer onramp: concise acceptance scenarios, prioritized risk ledger, and a short rollback/playbook for SRE and SE teams. This doc is intended to be the source of truth for the first 21 days of the pilot and for the on-call rota if degradation is observed.
objectives: Deliver a working inference pipeline that serves web chat and batch reranking for 100 concurrent users with 95th percentile latency < 350ms for chat generation
Validate Redwood routing fallback from hosted->dedicated under simulated capacity shortfall without user-visible errors
Demonstrate <20% unit cost improvement when enabling prefix caching + 4-bit quantization on the customer workload compared to baseline
timeline_and_gates: Day 0–2: infra provisioning and baseline smoke tests (gate: all endpoints respond 200 for sample prompt set)
Day 3–7: integration with customer datasets and telemetry; run load ramp to 25% target (gate: 95th p90 latency within 25% of baseline)
Day 8–14: performance tuning, cache warmup, and rollout to canary (gate: canary stable for 48h and no drop in quality as measured by the prompt test suite)
Day 15–21: full ramp and acceptance review (gate: acceptance sign-off from Catalyst product manager and infra owner)
Go/no-go cadence: daily stand + gating checklist review; final acceptance on Day 21
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario A — Happy path: customer sends web chat traffic; model responds with structured tool call JSON for 95% of test cases; SLO met: 95th latency < 350ms
Scenario B — Degraded capacity: route to compatible smaller model automatically; returned responses must contain 'fallback_reason' header and maintain syntactic validity for all tool calls
Scenario C — Data edge: user prompt contains PII; platform must not send that content to external third-party telemetry and must mark event with customer-data flag
Scenario D — Batch reranking: nightly batch runs complete within 2 hours and ranking accuracy (NDCG@10) within 3% of baseline model
success_metrics: Latency: 95th percentile per-request generation < 350ms (chat), < 500ms (rerank) for target concurrency
Cost: tokens-per-response unit cost within 20% of projected optimized profile
Quality: prompt test suite pass rate >= 92% (weighted by critical intents)
Reliability: no more than 1% error-rate for production endpoints during 72-hour stable window
Observability: all calls contain trace id and model-version metadata; no missing traces in sampling (target < 0.1% sampling loss)
risk_ledger: Risk: Model hallucination on product-safety prompts — Likelihood: medium; Impact: high; Mitigation: add prompt-level guardrails and safety filters, monitor false-positive/negative rates; Escalation: pause rollout and switch to conservative model family

Risk: Customer dataset contains nested JSON that breaks structured output parsing — Likelihood: medium; Impact: medium; Mitigation: add input sanitizer for nested structures and add unit tests for parsing edgecases

Risk: Unexpected spike in token usage from a third-party integration causing cost overrun — Likelihood: low; Impact: high; Mitigation: per-route quotas and hard caps; alerting for >200% daily spend deviation
Risk: Network egress constraints for private deployment — Likelihood: low; Impact: medium; Mitigation: use VPC peering and pre-authorize IP ranges; verify with network runbook before Day 3
failure_modes_and_rollbacks: Failure: Sustained latency degradation >50% for 2+ hours — Rollback: reroute traffic to hosted stable variant and scale up dedicated pool; notify SE + SRE; open incident ticket with priority P1
Failure: Canary shows 10% increase in hallucination scores — Rollback: revert to prior model version and enable conservative decoding params; run targeted evals before retry
Failure: Key management error for encrypted payloads — Rollback: fail closed (return 503) and switch to backup KMS, contact security and customer ops
operational_playbook: On-call SE runbook link: CONFLUENCE-OPS-559 (primary) — steps for triage and rollback
Key checks: token budget, cache hit-rate, KV-cache warm percentage, trace availability, model version mask
Alert thresholds: latency p95 > 300ms for 10m, error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, cache-hit < 40% for 15m
Communication: use #catalyst-poc Slack channel; escalate to account executive and SE manager after 30 minutes of mitigation attempts
workshop_agenda: Intro & success definition (15m) — align with Catalyst PM on use-cases
Data requirements review (20m) — formats, sample size, PII considerations
Ops & infra checklist (25m) — firewall rules, KMS, VPC peering, logs/metrics endpoints
Prompt test-suite walk-through (30m) — run 20 curated prompts and evaluate outputs
Q&A and action-items (20m) — owners and due dates for each gating item
data_and_test_requirements: Customer to share 2k anonymized chat transcripts in newline-delimited JSON
Sample schema: {"user_id": string, "session_id": string, "message": string, "timestamp": iso8601}
Minimum quality check: <1% malformed rows, else require resubmission
Test prompts: 40 curated prompts across 6 intents (support, billing, search, personalization, safety, misc)
Telemetry hooks: request_id, trace_id, model_version, route_id, latency_ms, token_count, cache_hit boolean
roles_and_responsibilities: Redwood-SE: Maya Chen — POC owner, integration lead, and daily stand host
Redwood-SRE: Evan Brooks — infra, scaling, and incident playbook owner
Customer-PM: Alex G. (Catalyst) — acceptance sign-off, priority intents
Customer-Infra: Simone Ortiz — VPC/KMS coordination and firewall approvals
decision_points: Enable quantization + caching during canary (yes/no) — risk: slight quality drop; reward: 15–25% cost savings
Switch fallback model family when dedicated capacity > 80% — automatic vs manual decision (recommend automatic with notification)
Increase reserved capacity during Day 10 load test — approve if p95 latency gap > 20%
next_steps: SE to provision canary environment and provide test endpoint by Day 2
Customer to upload anonymized dataset to shared bucket by Day 3
Run baseline suite and post results to Confluence page CONFLUENCE-ENG-1423 by Day 4
Schedule readiness review on Day 7 and confirm gating checklist
notes_to_self: Keep the risk ledger updated during daily stand — mark mitigations as resolved with dates. Avoid heavy-handed changes during canary; prefer configuration-only adjustments ahead of model swaps.
